Steps for Visa

The following steps must be followed in case of Visa on Arrival.

Step 1:

Fill up the “Arrival Card” Fill up the Online Tourist Visa Form: You can fill this form in two different ways. Before you arrive: You can fill up the form from the official website of department of Immigration (nepaliport.immigration.gov.np/onlinevisa-mission/application) and print the receipt with bar code. At the Airport: You can fill out the form at the airport using the Kiosk machine. Note: If you fill the form online, the barcode receipt is only valid for 15 days. If you exceed 15 days, we must fill out the form once again.

Step 2 :

Make Payment at the bank according to your visa requirements and receive the receipt. On arrival visa fee: 15 Days – 30 USD | 30 Days – 50 USD| 90 Days – 125 USD

Step 3 :

Proceed to the Immigration Desk with your online form, payment receipts and your passport Hand in your documents to immigration officer for visa processing. He/she issues visa to you upon his/her satisfaction. Visa Extension Fee

Gratis Visa Visa for Free

Gratis Visa is issued free of cost in case of following categories of Visa applicants:

  • Thailand – Exemption up to 90 Days
  • Russian Federation – Exemption up to 90 Days
  • People’s Republic of China – Exemption up to 30 Days
  • Federal Republic of Brazil – Exemption up to 90 Days
  • Myanmar – Exemption up to 90 Days
  • Vietnam – Exemption up to 90 Days
  • Cambodia – Exemption up to 30 Days
  • Mongolia – Exemption up to 90 Days
  • Jordan – Exemption up to 90 Days
  • State of Israel- Exemption up to 90 Days

  • State of Qatar – Exemption up to 90 Days.

Welcome to Wonder Himalaya

Wander Always, Wonder Often

Welcome to Wonder Himalaya. We’re a small team based in Thamel, Kathmandu, and we’ve spent years doing one thing — taking people into the mountains and bringing them back with stories they’ll tell for the rest of their lives.We run treks, tours, and expeditions across Nepal, Bhutan, Tibet, and India. From the teahouses of the Everest region to the monastery corridors of Lhasa, from the rhododendron forests of the Annapurna circuit to the fortress towns of Bhutan — this part of the world is what we know, and sharing it is what we do.Whether you’re planning your first Himalayan trek or your tenth expedition, you’re in the right place.

A Travelers' Choice — Not Just Our Claim

Every journey we’ve guided has been a shared story, and it isn’t us telling it. ‘Memorable,’ ‘exciting,’ ‘unforgettable’, these are the words our travelers have used to describe their time with Wonder Himalaya. We’ve helped countless trekkers reach their destinations, and many of them have taken the time to share their experience with others. This trust hasn’t gone unnoticed: Wonder Himalaya has been officially recognized by TripAdvisor with the Travelers’ Choice award, a true reflection of the confidence people places in us, journey after journey.

Our Trip of the Month

This month we're headed to Kanchenjunga — the world's third highest peak and one of Nepal's most remote, least-visited trekking regions. No crowds, no noise, just raw Himalayan wilderness the way it used to be.

Kanchenjunga Circuit Trek

Nepal's Last Great Wilderness Kanchenjunga sits in the far eastern corner of Nepal, untouched by mass tourism and unchanged by time. This is trekking the way it was always meant to be.
